name: The Tome of Divinity

angles.text: As a paladin, you learn that compassion and service matter as much as martial skill.
As a dwarf, you receive this instruction in Ironforge from mentors such as Tiza Battleforge, who teach you to guide strength with patience and virtue.

aliases: what is the tome of divinity
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity teaches novice paladins that divinity means striving to do good, aid the less fortunate, and show compassion, patience, and bravery rather than seeking godhood.
faq.q: What is the Tome of Divinity?

faq.answer: Tiza Battleforge is a paladin mentor in Ironforge. She guides novices through their first trials and teaches them to balance righteous combat with selfless service.
A paladin's power reflects the Light, so battle strength alone is not enough. Patience and compassion help paladins defend and uplift others.
faq.q: Why must paladins study patience and compassion?

aliases: what happens after reading the tome
faq.answer: After reading the tome, paladins demonstrate their virtues through practical trials. Mentors send them across Ironforge and nearby lands to help the needy and prove their devotion to the Light.
faq.q: What tests follow reading the book?

aliases: where is this quest turned in
faq.answer: After studying the tome, paladins return to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge, the dwarven capital.
faq.q: Where does this trial take place?

aliases: what does striving for divinity mean
faq.answer: Striving for divinity means choosing to do good in all things, not seeking godhood. Paladins use the Light to support and protect the people of Azeroth.
faq.q: What does it mean to strive for divinity?

sections.body: For a paladin, strength in battle must serve a higher purpose. Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge gives initiates the Tome of Divinity to teach them why they wield their arms. It turns their thoughts from dominion and godhood toward moral goodness. A paladin's calling is to serve as a steady instrument of the Light.
sections.title: The Measure of Divinity

sections.body: The tome teaches that smiting evil is not enough to make a paladin. Compassion, patience, and humility set these warriors apart from common combatants. After studying its words, initiates undertake trials in Ironforge and nearby lands. Through charity and service, they show sound judgment and unwavering devotion.
sections.title: Trials of Service and Compassion

summary: In Ironforge, Tiza Battleforge teaches young paladins what the Light asks of them. The Tome of Divinity says devotion calls for patience, compassion, and humble service to the needy, alongside martial strength.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Tome of Divinity
